answer: The ocean report shows the merge explicitly at each thread. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 97 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 286 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one oasis weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 1355 identities would post 2682 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
